messages:
bob_acme: Getting a 413 on /v1/rerank. Response body says \"request payload too large\" but not sure if the limit is on tokens, characters, or number of docs. Happening when we send ~28 docs plus a long query. Can you advise?

alice_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error body and a minimal repro? Also which model & rerank endpoint are you calling (rerank vs relevance)?

bob_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwo od.inference/v1/rerank -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" -d '{"model":"redwood-rerank-1","query":"This is a very long query text ... (6k chars)","documents":["<doc1: 3kb>","<doc2: 4kb>","... 28 total ..."]}'

Error: HTTP 413
{
  "error": "payload too large",
  "message": "request entity too large"
}

I tried truncating the query to 1k chars and still hit it. When I reduce docs down to 10 smaller docs it works. So not sure which dimension is being checked.

alice_support: Thanks. I'll escalate to eng-ml and SRE with the payload sample. In the meantime, two quick workarounds: 1) send fewer docs per rerank call and batch/range them client-side, or 2) send pre-filtered candidate doc IDs and call rerank with shorter contexts.

alice_support: @carlos_eng can you take a look? this one looks like a limit we should make clearer in the error message / docs.

carlos_eng: On it — can you attach the exact curl (redact tokens) and the full response headers? If you have the content-length value from the request that would help. Also which region/edge you hit?

bob_acme: Pasting trimmed curl and response headers:

Request headers:
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 412345
Host: api.redwood-inference.com

Response headers:
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
X-Request-Id: rq_abc123

Hope that helps.

carlos_eng: Yep — Content-Length ~412 KB. That puts us above the gateway 400KB soft limit for synchronous endpoints in this region (we should verify). @dana_sre do we have an ingress protection limit that would 413 for rerank?

dana_sre: We enforce a proxy body size of 512KB at the edge, but some internal frontends apply an application-layer guard around 256KB for the rerank path to avoid OOM when building pairwise inputs. That guard is not currently surfaced in the API error beyond a generic 413.

alice_support: That explains the behavior: big docs -> Content-Length exceeds app guard -> 413. Customer-reported repro where reducing docs to 10 worked because payload went under the guard.

alice_support: Action items: 1) eng-ml to add a clearer error body (e.g., "payload too large: total_documents_size_exceeded" with suggested limits), 2) docs team to call out approximate limits and client-side chunking patterns, 3) create a KB entry with suggested chunking code.

carlos_eng: I'll add a small server-side change to include a hint field in the 413 response and add a unit test that reproduces with large pairwise construction. I'll also add a note to the internal runbook with the thresholds.

alice_support: Bob, quick workaround you can try now: compute simple vector similarity to pre-filter to top-N candidates (call embeddings or use your existing index) and then call rerank just on that subset (e.g., 12–16 docs). That keeps quality and avoids the 413.

bob_acme: Thanks — we'll implement the pre-filter. One question: any ETA on making the error message clearer? Right now it's blocking our integration testing because our infra assumes 413 means upload limit rather than doc-size.

carlos_eng: I'll push a tiny payload change today to include a JSON hint field when we detect application-body > threshold. If all goes well it should be in a canary by end of day. No promise on full docs update timeline.

ingress-bot: Note: rule update scheduled for edge group eu-west-1 to increase proxy buffer to 768KB on 2026-08-12 03:00 UTC (rolling).

alice_support: Marking this with internal tag support:rerank:413 and opening KB PR. Bob, I'll DM you the test script for client-side chunking patterns.

bob_acme: Appreciate it — workaround works for now. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:

carlos_eng: Follow-up: we'll expose an explicit error code and hint in the next SDK/HTTP response so integrators can programmatically retry with chunking. Will post updates here when canary is live.

alice_support: Closing loop once canary confirmed. Thanks everyone.
